verses.english: “Mendicants, I will teach you an exposition of the teaching, an explanation of one who has found sanctuary from the yoke.
And what is an exposition of the teaching, an explanation of one who has found sanctuary from the yoke?

verses.pali: Santi, bhikkhave, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṁhitā rajanīyā.
verses.english: There are sights known by the eye, which are likable, desirable, agreeable, pleasant, sensual, and arousing.

verses.pali: Te tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅkatā āyatiṁ anuppādadhammā.
verses.english: The Realized One has given these up, cut them off at the root, made them like a palm stump, and obliterated them, so they are unable to arise in the future.

verses.pali: Tesañca pahānāya akkhāsi yogaṁ, tasmā tathāgato ‘yogakkhemī’ti vuccati …pe…
verses.english: He teaches yoking oneself to meditation for giving them up. That’s why the Realized One is called one who has found sanctuary from the yoke. …

verses.pali: santi, bhikkhave, manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṁhitā rajanīyā.
verses.english: There are ideas known by the mind, which are likable, desirable, agreeable, pleasant, sensual, and arousing.

verses.pali: Te tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅkatā āyatiṁ anuppādadhammā.
verses.english: The Realized One has given these up, cut them off at the root, made them like a palm stump, and obliterated them, so they are unable to arise in the future.

verses.pali: Tesañca pahānāya akkhāsi yogaṁ, tasmā tathāgato ‘yogakkhemī’ti vuccati.
verses.english: He teaches yoking oneself to meditation for giving them up. That’s why the Realized One is called one who has found sanctuary from the yoke.
This is an exposition of the teaching, an explanation of one who has found sanctuary from the yoke.”
